prompt:
Create ONE original game-ready material atlas for a nineteenth-century Argentine dark-fantasy FPS, matching a restrained hand-painted realistic game texture style. Flat neutral illumination, no cast shadows, no glossy highlights. The output is a rectangular atlas with exactly FOUR equal-width columns and FIVE equal-height rows, twenty rectangular material cells. Cells meet directly edge-to-edge: no borders, labels, letters, numbers, gutters or margins. Every material fills its own cell. Do not draw characters, a scene, clothing silhouettes or a contact sheet. Faces in row 1 are planar texture maps cropped from forehead to chin, both eyes and mouth fully visible, no neck/ears/hair/background; same frontal alignment, eyes near 27 percent cell height, nose tip near 53 percent, mouth near 74 percent. The face fills each rectangular cell.
Row 1 left to right: (1) adult stocky forest goblin male face, warm copper brown skin, broad rounded nose, mature heavy brow, strong cheekbones, dark brown eyes, clean-shaven, subtle weathered creases, neutral stern expression, NO beard; (2) elongated ash-gray wooden mask-like adult spectral face with dark recessed eyes, long narrow nose, pointed chin, restrained sad mouth, dry bark/bone striations, no hair; (3) adult masculine human-avian face, pale ivory gray skin, amber eyes, angular brow, small strongly hooked beak-like nose integrated into an otherwise human face, no feathers covering the eyes; (4) nonhuman ivory-gray birdlike skull mask front, dark deep eye sockets with small dark eyes, long slender narrow beak, porous worn stone/bone texture, no teeth or human lips.
Row 2 left to right: (5) seamless warm copper brown weathered goblin skin; (6) fibrous charcoal gray ash-bark skin; (7) subtle pale gray and ivory scaled avian skin; (8) weathered dark gray bone and stone skin with fine fissures, no scattered props.
Row 3 left to right: (9) long coarse dark brown hair flowing vertically, dense strands; (10) long charcoal gray hair and fine dry bark fibers flowing vertically; (11) overlapping layered slate-gray flight feathers with muted warm tan edges, orderly downward orientation, no wing outline; (12) overlapping ivory and pale ochre feathers, same orientation and scale as cell11.
Row 4 left to right: (13) coarse brown burlap and bark-weave fabric, subtle stitched rectangular patches; (14) ragged dark gray brown woven cloth texture, no garment outline; (15) overlapping dry olive and brown leaves, directional pointed leaves downwards, subdued; (16) aged dull bronze material with faint hammer texture, no object.
Row 5 left to right: (17) coarse tan braided rope texture, closely packed vertical braids; (18) worn ivory bone and horn texture with faint longitudinal striations; (19) dark charcoal horn/claw material, faint lengthwise grain, no claw silhouette; (20) gray-brown coarse fabric bearing simple muted pale ivory diamond and chevron painted marks, no letters or culturally attributed symbols.
No copyrighted game assets. Original texture pixels only. Keep all twenty cells clearly separated by their content without visible grid lines. Consistent subdued palette and scale, readable material structure, faces aligned and undistorted.
reviewed: All20cells: four aligned distinct faces, skin, hair, feathers, woven material, leaf, bronze, rope, bone, horn and pale geometric cloth. No image edits.
review: Four facial cells and sixteen material swatches. Original RGB1122x1402 image bytes retained, with explicit UV rectangles following actual boundaries.
